name: Node + Postgres App
description: A Node.js web app backed by a managed PostgreSQL database. Two real Zerops services on a private network, with a public subdomain on the webapp. Deliberately small so it builds and boots reliably during a live demo.

services.name: webapp
services.description: Node.js HTTP server rendering the app and writing to Postgres over the project's private network

services.name: db
services.description: Zerops-managed PostgreSQL 16, reachable only inside the project as db:5432
